easy.set: Six animals in the stories of the Qur'an
easy.explain: Each of these animals has a part in a story of the Qur'an.

easy.set: The steps of wudu named in Al-Ma'idah 5:6
items: Wash the arms up to the elbows
Wash the feet up to the ankles
easy.explain: Al-Ma'idah 6 names washing the face, the arms to the elbows, wiping the head and washing the feet to the ankles.

easy.set: The phrases of the adhan, in order
items: I testify there is no god but Allah
I testify Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah
easy.explain: Abdullah ibn Zayd saw the words of the adhan in a dream, and the Prophet ﷺ confirmed them and told Bilal to call them.

medium.set: Surahs named after a woman or women
medium.explain: An-Nisa means the women, Maryam is named after the mother of Isa, Al-Mujadila is the woman who pleaded, and Al-Mumtahanah the woman who is examined.

medium.set: Seven surahs named after a group of people
medium.explain: These are named after the believers, the hypocrites, the disbelievers, the poets, the Romans, the tribe of Quraysh and mankind.
They are named after the pen, iron, the table spread, ornaments of gold and the palm-fibre rope.

medium.set: Surahs named after something in nature
medium.explain: They are named after the thunder, the smoke, the earthquake and the scattering winds.
The Qur'an calls itself the Book, the Criterion, the Reminder, a light and a healing.

medium.set: Names of Paradise in the Qur'an
medium.explain: The Qur'an speaks of the Gardens of Firdaws, of Eden, of Refuge, the Home of Peace and the Gardens of Delight.

hard.set: Teacher to student among the imams: Malik, al-Shafi'i, Ahmad
hard.explain: Al-Shafi'i studied under Malik in Madinah, and Ahmad ibn Hanbal studied under al-Shafi'i.
Al-Nawawi wrote Riyad as-Salihin, the Forty Hadith, al-Adhkar, a commentary on Sahih Muslim and al-Majmu' in Shafi'i fiqh.
Ibn Kathir wrote his famous tafsir and the history al-Bidaya wan-Nihaya. Qisas al-Anbiya, the stories of the prophets, is drawn from it.
Ibn Hajar wrote Fath al-Bari on al-Bukhari, Bulugh al-Maram, al-Isabah on the companions and Tahdhib al-Tahdhib on narrators.
Ibn al-Qayyim wrote Zad al-Ma'ad on the Prophet's guidance, Madarij as-Salikin, I'lam al-Muwaqqi'in and al-Jawab al-Kafi.
Ibn al-Qayyim, Ibn Kathir and al-Dhahabi all studied with Ibn Taymiyyah in Damascus. Al-Nawawi died before him, Ibn Hajar lived after.

hard.set: Peoples Surah Al-Fajr mentions being punished
hard.explain: Al-Fajr 6 to 13 mentions 'Ad and Iram, Thamud who hewed the rocks, and Fir'awn of the stakes.

hard.set: Peoples listed in Surah Qaf 50:12 to 14
hard.explain: Qaf 12 to 14 lists these peoples, who all denied the messengers.
As-Saffat names Nuh, Ibrahim, Ishaq, Musa, Harun, Ilyas, Lut and Yunus.

hard.set: Names of the Last Day in the Qur'an
items: Yawm at-Taghabun (the Day of Mutual Loss)
hard.explain: The Qur'an calls the Last Day by many names, among them these five.

hard.set: Names of Hell in the Qur'an
hard.explain: The Qur'an names the Fire Jahannam, Saqar, al-Hutamah, al-Hawiyah and al-Jahim, among others.
